title: Comet Keeper
tagline: You are the moon that guards a small living world. Knock the comets away.
description: One thumb drags anywhere to swing a silver moon around a fixed orbit. Comets stream in from the dark: a comet that touches the moon is deflected, and a deflected comet that hits another comet destroys both for a chain. A comet that reaches the world cracks it, and three cracks end the run. Four short waves of forty-five seconds, then endless, with new comet types each wave and one upgrade of three between waves. PULSE is a ring blast that pushes nearby comets away and recharges in twelve seconds. Best score is saved.

desktop: Swing the moon to the cursor's angle around the world
touch: Swing the moon to your thumb's angle around the world
Ring blast that pushes nearby comets outward
Start, pick an upgrade, play again
gamepad: Point the stick where the moon should go
Pause, or start from the title
